title: [Feature/Canvas]: Canvas Split-Depth 3D Pop-Out Illusion & Parallax Occlusion Bar Generator
body:
## Problem
Arcade promo banners and game previews on the homepage are flat 2D cards. Physical arcade promotional posters and hologram cards frequently utilized lenticular lenses to create striking 3D pop-out illusions without 3D glasses.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Split-Depth 3D Canvas Compositor (`assets/js/split-depth-3d.js`):**
   - Generates dynamic vertical or horizontal white occlusion depth bars over game animations.
   - By selectively layering foreground game elements (e.g. projectiles, character heads, flying coins) *in front* of the bars while keeping the background *behind*, creates a stunning optical brain illusion of 3D depth pop-out.
2. **Interactive Parallax Cursor Tilt:**
   - Tilts the depth bars and parallax layers in reaction to mouse pointer movement or mobile gyroscope orientation.
3. **Interactive Visual Studio for Game Covers:**
   - Provides an interactive tool allowing game creators to test split-depth 3D overlays for their games.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Convincing optical 3D pop-out effect in pure 2D Canvas without WebGL or VR glasses.
- [ ] Solid 60 FPS performance with zero memory leaks.
- [ ] Graceful fallback to flat 2D on low-power devices.

title: [Feature/Physics]: 2D Inverse Kinematics (IK) FABRIK Multi-Joint Tentacle & Ragdoll Physics Engine
body:
## Problem
Boss monsters, alien tentacles, grappling ropes, and robotic arms in arcade games are notoriously difficult to animate naturally using manual frame-by-frame sprites, often leading to stiff and repetitive enemy animations.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Pure Vanilla FABRIK / CCD 2D IK Solver (`assets/js/inverse-kinematics-physics.js`):**
   - Implements the Forward And Backward Reaching Inverse Kinematics (FABRIK) algorithm for n-joint kinematic chains in 2D space.
   - Solves target reach positions iteratively within 3-5 iterations per frame with joint angle constraints (min/max angle limits).
2. **Procedural Multi-Tentacle & Mechanical Arm Generators:**
   - Built-in generators for segmented robotic arms, alien boss tentacles, and dynamic character limbs that automatically reach toward mouse/player targets.
3. **Modular Helper for Game Creators:**
   - Exposes `ArcadeVerse.physics.createIKChain(jointsCount, segmentLength, constraints)` for instant integration into boss fights and physics games.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Solves multi-segment kinematic chains in under 0.1ms per frame using FABRIK math.
- [ ] Realistic joint angular constraints preventing unnatural backward bending.
- [ ] Comprehensive unit tests verifying solver convergence and boundary clamping.
